# Native payment reference

`native-payment.json` is an independently invented protocol vector generated by
published `@solana/web3.js` 1.66.1. It contains no keys or production data. The
nonzero signature slot is synthetic and unverified. It tests a legacy transaction
with a separate durable-nonce authority, compute limit, memo and ordered native
transfers (including a zero amount). It is not a genuine WP/TAT producer export.

With that exact reference package installed externally, regenerate and compare:

```sh
NODE_PATH=/path/to/reference/node_modules node reference/generate-native-payment.cjs | diff -u test/fixtures/native-payment.json -
```

The package is used only to generate test data; it is not a runtime dependency.
